protocol.healthy_gate: Geometric mean candidate/control <=1.02 and each case <=1.05, using per-role median process means over four ABBA blocks. Every healthy call must succeed. Failed-frame control errors are not speed references.
protocol.isolation: No other task-owned campaigns active; same image, compiler and CPUs, alternating order.
protocol.recovery_gate: All three exact failed frames and their repeated/new-epoch calls certify. Record cold latency and peak RSS; never compare an error against a valid solution as a speedup.

cost.timing_scope: Isolated task-owned campaigns; same Apptainer image, GCC flags, CPUs and ABBA order. Healthy samples mix normal, transpose and combined refactor/solve calls. Recovery controls fail, so their timings are not valid-solution speed references.

behavior.trigger: Observed DEFAULT componentwise failure after bounded correction, AUTO scaling requested and an unscaled incumbent. Kernel failures are not certified.
behavior.attempts: At most MAX then SUM scaling, with one isolated proposal live at a time and recursive recovery disabled.
behavior.acceptance: All RHSs independently pass the unchanged componentwise check against the current original operator before any publication or factor retention.
behavior.reuse: The incumbent is tried first on every RHS. A recovery factor is reused only after actual failure, within one numeric epoch. Public numeric updates and reanalysis discard it.
behavior.preserved: Explicit scaling requests, original pivot options, accuracy policy, atomic multi-RHS output and failure rollback. No ordering or parallel-executor admission changes.

limits: The unchanged bips07_1998 factorization failure remains at both thread counts; all failures were retained.
Both official SuiteSparse download routes returned HTTP 403 for all 24 predefined generalization-manifest entries. The numerical corpus is the frozen 69-matrix available set, not an unseen holdout.
Initial invalid CPU-affinity launches never reached the solver; archived under invalid-affinity folders and excluded from numerical results.

Recovery may retain an additional factor and pays cold factorization again after a numeric update. Reported RSS and latency are observations on three captured operators, not a global memory or wall-time bound.

This patch establishes robustness and measured healthy-path nonregression, not that KLS is fastest. Full forced-ND BJT previously remained unqualified; no forced-ND performance or production admission is claimed here.
